name: iChurch
shortDescription: A United Reformed Church-supported WordPress website service for churches and faith organisations, combining hosting, church themes, training and optional managed content updates.
suitableContexts: United Reformed Church congregations and pastorates
Other UK churches seeking a supported WordPress website
Churches that want optional help uploading content rather than managing every update themselves

pricing.summary: Published pricing lists iChurch at £11.99/month, iChurch+ at £16.99/month and a £175 one-off website setup fee; all stated prices exclude VAT. The supplier also lists optional unlimited email at £4.99/month. Confirm current terms, multi-church charges, domain arrangements and any managed-content limits before ordering.

startingPrice.qualifier: standard iChurch plan, excluding VAT and separate setup fee

tiers.label: iChurch
tiers.detail: Supplier lists WordPress website, secure domain and hosting, theme/security/plugin updates, training and support.

tiers.label: iChurch+
tiers.detail: Supplier adds quarterly content uploads, discounted training and performance reviews.

tiers.label: Website set-up
tiers.detail: Supplier says additional fees apply to websites for multiple churches.

gdprInformation: The reviewed material establishes that iChurch uses WordPress and describes hosting provision through VTSDesign, but does not establish a current product-specific DPA, hosting location, sub-processor list, backup schedule or controller/processor responsibilities. Obtain those terms before publishing sensitive personal data or accepting detailed enquiries through the site.
integrations: Supplier states that iChurch uses WordPress
Supplier describes hosting provision through VTSDesign
Recommended plugins include contact forms, events calendar, accessibility tools, security and SEO tools
importExport: The product is based on WordPress; confirm ownership, administrator access, database/media export, domain transfer and handover arrangements in the current agreement
support: Supplier publishes training videos, help sheets, online training and an iChurch community
iChurch+ includes supplier-uploaded content on a quarterly basis according to published pricing

operator-and-scope.value: The iChurch site states that it sits within the United Reformed Church Communications Department in London and is open to all denominations.

urc-context.value: The United Reformed Church describes iChurch as its service to help churches and community groups build and manage a website.

pricing.value: Published pricing lists standard, managed-update and setup charges, together with an optional email service, and says all prices exclude VAT.

technical-model.value: Supplier states that iChurch uses WordPress and describes hosting provision through VTSDesign, plus training and support resources.

editorial.assessment: iChurch is a supported WordPress website service run through the United Reformed Church, not a general church management system. It is especially relevant to URC churches, but the supplier says other denominations can use it. Its published prices and optional content service may suit a small team; still obtain the current agreement and check website ownership, data protection, content downloads, accessibility and support limits.
bestFor: Churches wanting a WordPress site with training and routine technical updates
Small teams that may need optional help uploading content
strengths: Published monthly, setup and optional-email prices
WordPress foundation with training and support
limitations: Not a church database, online-giving processor, safeguarding system or booking-management suite
Current DPA, hosting location, sub-processors, backups and data-exit terms are not established in the reviewed material
iChurch+ content uploads are described as quarterly, so confirm responsiveness for urgent updates
Confirm domain, admin access, WordPress plugin governance and accessibility responsibilities in the current contract

procurementVerdict.problem: Running a maintained church website without relying on a single volunteer for technical upkeep
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A URC-supported, WordPress-based church website service with training, community support and an optional managed-update tier
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Build a representative services, events, sermons and contact page with the current theme; then obtain the DPA, hosting/backup details, WordPress administrator and export arrangements, and service levels for routine and urgent updates
